 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Composite the four 4x4 color masks using the observed layer order."""
    # The 3-valued columns separate four 4x4 masks: 8, 5, 9, and 4.
    panels = [
        [[grid[r][c] for c in range(0, 4)] for r in range(4)],
        [[grid[r][c] for c in range(5, 9)] for r in range(4)],
        [[grid[r][c] for c in range(10, 14)] for r in range(4)],
        [[grid[r][c] for c in range(15, 19)] for r in range(4)],
    ]
    # Later/front layers cover earlier layers: 9 > 4 > 8 > 5.
    priority = (9, 4, 8, 5)
    out = []
    for r in range(4):
        row = []
        for c in range(4):
            present = {p[r][c] for p in panels if p[r][c] != 0}
            row.append(next((color for color in priority if color in present), 0))
        out.append(row)
    return out
"
